accepted_blocks.source:
template<S set>:
    have sequence set = fn(n N+) S

\sequence<R> = fn(n N+) R
\sequence<R> = \sequence<R>
0 ∉ N+
accepted_blocks.lesson: The Template Result owns S as its outer parameter; the nested set-alias Result owns the function-set binder n. The first application is Created, later uses are Reused, and N+ excludes zero.
